name: AI Chat Export by José DA COSTA
tagline: Export AI conversations to Markdown with all links preserved.
description: Browser extension to export AI chatbot conversations to clean Markdown. Works on ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, Grok, and Mistral, keeping every source link and citation intact. No data collection.

features.title: Export to Markdown
features.description: Saves the full conversation as a clean, readable Markdown file.

features.title: Links preserved
features.description: Keeps every source link and citation intact in the export.

features.title: Multi-platform
features.description: Works on ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, Grok, and Mistral.

features.title: One-click download
features.description: Grabs the current conversation straight from the page, no copy-paste.
